messages.text:
The standalone browser probe against the same dev URL now shows the preview opens (`dialog count = 1`), so the previous e2e result may have been from the pre-fix server bundle or a remaining mobile-only stack issue.

I’m rerunning the browser suite cleanly; if dock interception remains, I’ll patch the structural stacking rather than the test.
